## Total days of wearables data

- `DateCount`: count of the number of distinct combinations of ParticipantIdentifier and Date
- `Median`: median number of days of data per participant

```{r}
distinct_dates <- 
  lapply(summary_stats, function(p) {
    lapply(p, function(c) {
      lapply(c, function(m) {
        n_distinct(m$ParticipantIdentifier, m$date)
      })
    })
  })


median_days <- 
  lapply(summary_stats, function(p) {
    lapply(p, function(c) {
      lapply(c, function(m) {
        m %>% 
          group_by(ParticipantIdentifier) %>% 
          distinct(date) %>% 
          count(date) %>% 
          summarise(tot = sum(n)) %>% 
          summarise(med = median(tot)) %>% 
          as.numeric()
      })
    })
  })

distinct_dates_df <- 
  tibble::tibble(
    Platform = rep(names(distinct_dates), times = sapply(distinct_dates, function(x) length(unlist(x)))),
    Category = unlist(lapply(distinct_dates, function(x) rep(names(x), each = length(unlist(x[[1]]))))),
    Measure = unlist(lapply(distinct_dates, function(x) unlist(lapply(x, names)))),
    DateCount = unlist(distinct_dates),
    Median = unlist(median_days)
  )

distinct_dates_df %>% 
  knitr::kable(format = "markdown", format.args = list(big.mark = ","))

write.csv(distinct_dates_df, "distinct_dates_df.csv", row.names = F)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
synapser::File("distinct_dates_df.csv", 
               description = "Count of unique dates of wearables data", 
               parent = "syn61671543") %>% 
  synapser::synStore()
```

## Range of unique dates of wearables data

```{r}
distinct_date_ranges <- 
  lapply(summary_stats, function(p) {
    lapply(p, function(c) {
      lapply(c, function(m) {
        summary(m$date)
      })
    })
  })

convert_to_table <- function(data) {
  result <- tibble::tibble(Platform = character(),
                           Category = character(),
                           Measure = character(),
                           Min = Date(),
                           Q1 = Date(),
                           Median = Date(),
                           Mean = Date(),
                           Q3 = Date(),
                           Max = Date())
  
  for (platform in names(data)) {
    for (category in names(data[[platform]])) {
      for (measure in names(data[[platform]][[category]])) {
        summary_stats2 <- data[[platform]][[category]][[measure]]
        result <- result %>%
          add_row(
            Platform = platform,
            Category = category,
            Measure = measure,
            Min = as.Date(as.numeric(summary_stats2["Min."])),
            Q1 = as.Date(as.numeric(summary_stats2["1st Qu."])),
            Median = as.Date(as.numeric(summary_stats2["Median"])),
            Mean = as.Date(as.numeric(summary_stats2["Mean"])),
            Q3 = as.Date(as.numeric(summary_stats2["3rd Qu."])),
            Max = as.Date(as.numeric(summary_stats2["Max."]))
          )
      }
    }
  }
  
  return(result)
}

distinct_date_ranges_table <- convert_to_table(distinct_date_ranges)

distinct_date_ranges_table %>% 
  knitr::kable(format = "markdown", format.args = list(big.mark = ","))

write.csv(distinct_date_ranges_table, "distinct_date_ranges_table.csv", row.names = F)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
synapser::File("distinct_date_ranges_table.csv", 
               description = "Range of unique dates of wearables data", 
               parent = "syn61671543") %>% 
  synapser::synStore()
```
